# John Young

John Young is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

John Young has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 with 27.3% of the vote.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111129110827/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-brelade-district-1/john-young)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928133630/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=84)
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young#e19)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/john-young-3/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20150219163339/http://www.johnhyoung.com/my-policies/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wpnTORCXe14)
- [**2016 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young#e22)

  Not elected.

  - [2016 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2016/john-young-2/)
  - [2016 Full Manifesto](http://www.johnhyoung.com/my-manifesto-for-2016-summary/)
  - [2016 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/jerseys-senatorial-by-election-2016-qs-as/)
  - [2016 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4GV34hKr0zY)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/john-young/)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](http://www.johnhyoung.com/my-policies/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k-Fx5GQpUeA)

John Young has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/02/former-environment-minister-to-seek-states-return-and-joins-reform-jersey/)\]

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Brelade No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade-no-1) (1 seat), 7th September 2011.

**John Young was elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 in 2011**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **John Young** |  | 339 | 27.3% |
| 2 | [Margaret Holland-Prior](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/margaret-holland-prior) |  | 306 | 24.6% |
| 3 | [Jeff Hathaway](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jeff-hathaway) |  | 285 | 22.9% |
| 4 | [Angela Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune) |  | 276 | 22.2% |

1,244 votes (inc. 38 spoilt papers)

2,536 registered voters

= 49.1% turnout
